result.title: Fair Bubble Sort: Provably Optimal Fair Ranking with Continuous Sensitive Attributes
result.comment: 35 pages, 9 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Code: https://github.com/Ambress92/FairBubbleSort
result.summary: Most fair-ranking methods assume categorical protected attributes, requiring continuous attributes such as age or income to be discretized into groups. This introduces arbitrary thresholds, loses fine-grained information, and ignores the natural ordering of the attribute. In this paper, we study the problem of fair ranking with continuous protected attributes without relying on thresholding. We introduce Continuous Pairwise Parity (CPP), a fairness notion based on Kendall correlation between ranking positions and the protected attribute, and seek rankings that satisfy a prescribed CPP constraint while minimizing their Kemeny distance from an initial score-based ranking. To solve this problem, we propose Fair Bubble Sort (FBS), an efficient post-processing algorithm based on targeted adjacent swaps. We prove that FBS is exactly optimal for the unweighted Kemeny distance and provide approximation guarantees for the score-weighted setting. FBS is output-sensitive, with running time determined by the number of swaps required to meet the fairness constraint. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets show that FBS is scalable and consistently outperforms discretization-based baselines, achieving a superior fairness-accuracy Pareto front.

AI.brief_summary: 研究连续敏感属性下的公平排序：提出基于 Kendall 相关的 CPP 公平性约束，以及通过定向相邻交换、以 Kemeny 距离最小为目标的后处理算法 Fair Bubble Sort，并给出最优性与近似保证。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属公平排序的组合优化与理论分析，不涉及视觉或多模态表示、生成式推理状态、训练监督或证据获取与停止决策，「相邻交换」等线索也仅是排序算法本身，与 LVR 问题缺乏实质可借鉴联系，故排除。
